pages.content:
A dense deepslate block laced with calcified fossils and ancient energetic veins.

§6Mining & Distribution§r
Generates deep underground in deepslate strata between §bY = -64 and Y = 0§r (most common around §bY = -32§r) as single-block deposits. Mining it requires a pickaxe and awards 2-5 experience points alongside the block.

§6Significance§r
Mysterious Stone is the only natural source of dormant §5Petrified Eyes§r, and serves as the heat-focusing base needed to assemble the §5Soul Cauldron§r.
